newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms to seek 22,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms to seek 22,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy 22,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said.
Of the total, Cheiljedang would buy 9,000 tonnes at basis prices over December futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour would seek the remaining 13,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for September 10-October 10 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
